name: MediaHue – Media Rename & Auto Alt Text
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
MediaHue – Media Rename & Auto Alt Text helps you clean and optimize your WordPress media library automatically.

This plugin improves media SEO by renaming files and generating missing metadata based on image filenames.

Key Features

  • Rename media files directly from the Media Library
  • Automatically add Alt Text to images that are missing it
  • Generate image Titles from file names
  • Generate Captions for images with missing captions
  • SEO-friendly and lightweight
  • Works with existing media — no reupload required

Perfect for improving accessibility and image SEO without manual effort.

Credits

Developed by Kirtikumar Solanki.
Donations welcome via PayPal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mediahue-media-rename-auto-alt-text folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
    OR install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Media → MediaHue Media Customizer Settings.
  4. Enable the options you want (rename media, auto alt text, titles, captions).
  5. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin rename existing images?

Yes. You can rename existing media files safely from the Media Library.

Will this affect image URLs on my site?

The plugin handles renaming safely, but it is recommended to take a backup before bulk operations.

Does it work with WooCommerce images?

Yes, WooCommerce product images stored in the Media Library are supported.

Is this plugin SEO-friendly?

Yes. Automatically generated alt text, titles, and captions improve image SEO and accessibility.
